name: mac-docker
prompt:
kk-engine (C++20, Vulkan through volk, CMake + Ninja) gets a macOS CI job: soucouyant cross-compiles an x86_64 macOS package on Linux with osxcross (clang 18, macOS SDK 26.1, image docker/macos.Dockerfile), and a 2018 Intel MacBook Air (macOS 14, MoltenVK, Forgejo runner label macos-amd64, host mode, started on demand) only unpacks that package and runs the unit tests. Write the new file docker/macos.Dockerfile, the image the macOS build job runs in. Follow the style of docker/ci.Dockerfile (given): a header comment block, then the steps.
1. Header comment, in this order: what it is (the CI image for .forgejo/workflows/macos.yml: kke-ci plus osxcross, to cross-compile the Intel macOS package on soucouyant); that, like ci.Dockerfile, it is built by hand on soucouyant and pushed with exactly these two command lines:
`#   docker build -f docker/macos.Dockerfile -t git.kreative-kompas.com/khyretos/kke-macos:<n> .` and `#   docker push git.kreative-kompas.com/khyretos/kke-macos:<n>`, bumping <n> on every change; and why compiler-rt is added: SDL3's Cocoa code calls `__isPlatformVersionAtLeast` (behind `@available`), which lives in clang's builtins library libclang_rt.osx.a, and Ubuntu's clang has none for macOS, so the file is taken from LLVM's own 18.1.8 macOS release (the same clang version).
2. `ARG OSXCROSS_VERSION=26.1-r0` then `FROM crazymax/osxcross:${OSXCROSS_VERSION}-ubuntu AS osxcross`.
3. `FROM git.kreative-kompas.com/khyretos/kke-ci:1` and `ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive`.
4. One RUN: `apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends clang lld && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*`.
5. `COPY --from=osxcross /osxcross /osxcross`.
6. `ARG LLVM=18.1.8` and `ARG LLVM_SHA256=4573b7f25f46d2a9c8882993f091c52f416c83271db6f5b213c93f0bd0346a10`, then one RUN that, in /tmp: downloads `https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/releases/download/llvmorg-${LLVM}/clang+llvm-${LLVM}-arm64-apple-macos11.tar.xz` with `curl -fsSL -o llvm.tar.xz`, checks it with `echo "${LLVM_SHA256}  llvm.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -`, extracts only `clang+llvm-${LLVM}-arm64-apple-macos11/lib/clang/18/lib/darwin/libclang_rt.osx.a` (tar -xJf ... <that path>), creates /usr/lib/llvm-18/lib/clang/18/lib/darwin with mkdir -p, moves the file there, and deletes the tarball and the extracted folder. Join the commands with `&&` and ` \` line ends.
7. `ENV PATH=/osxcross/bin:$PATH LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/osxcross/lib`.
Nothing else: no CMD, no USER, no WORKDIR.
